== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-10-reaper|Hollow Armor is an [[Enforcer technique]] that allows a user to protect and empower their physical form using [[madra]]. While the specific appearance and function of the armor vary depending on an individual's unique [[madra]], it generally manifests as a suit of plates or a shimmering layer covering the body. The [[technique]] provides significant defensive capabilities, such as the ability to withstand powerful attacks or leap great distances, but it functions by consuming the user's [[madra]] reserves. If a user runs out of energy, they must drop the [[technique]]. The armor can be highly specialized; for example, it can be constructed in layers using different types of [[madra]] to increase durability or integrated with other abilities like the [[Hollow King's Crown]] and Mantle. However, certain high-level energies, such as [[pure madra]], can interfere with the armor's stability and cause it to tear itself apart due to [[resonance]] issues.}}
